mechanism: Phenytoin induces CYP450 enzymes (primarily CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4) leading to increased metabolism and reduced chlorpromazine levels; chlorpromazine may lower phenytoin seizure threshold and increase phenytoin metabolism.
action: Monitor seizure control and consider chlorpromazine dosage adjustment or alternative antipsychotic with lower enzyme induction potential; ensure adequate seizure prophylaxis.
